text:
maria.garcia: Quick sync — trying to finish onboarding galaxia-7b. Need three checks before we flip this to hosted: 1) exact weights path, 2) tokenizer quirks (special tokens/mappings), 3) licensing/attribution gating. Can folks drop short updates? :eyes:
kevin.cho: weights uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-models/galaxia/7b/weights-v2.tar.gz. Serving config at repo: models/galaxia/7b/serving_config.yaml. md5 on the tarball is 9f3a... if you need. Will push a PR to pin model_version=2026-03-17.
sophia.lee: tokenizer note — it's a byte-level BPE fork with two nonstandard tokens: <|system_prompt|> and <|persona|>. Tokenizer.json currently maps them to ids 50265/50266 which conflict with our special-token reserve on some runtime configs. Quick fix is remap to 50290/50291 and add to tokenizer override in serving config. Example snippet I tested:```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
tok = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
# remap IDs
# ...pseudo ops...
```
ops-bot: deploy-checker: model size 13.8GB, quantization-friendly: yes, KV cache ok. Autoscale policy suggestion: min_replicas=2 for dedicated, but hosted can start with 1 and auto-burst.
dave_k: I'll draft a model card PR with attribution + known tokenizer caveats. Proposed attribution blurb: "Galaxia Labs — Galaxia-7B (trained on mixture of web and curated datasets). Licensed CC-BY-NC. Contact: legal@galaxia.example" — does legal want that verbatim?
legal-bot: heads-up: CC-BY-NC is a non-commercial license. For our hosted product that charges per-token, CC-BY-NC likely prohibits public hosting unless upstream grants explicit commercial rights. Two options: 1) request a commercial sublicense/waiver from Galaxia Labs, or 2) allow model in Dedicated/Private only and block hosted API. We need model_card to include license and link, and a license_check flag in onboarding metadata.
maria.garcia: ok — can legal confirm if we should block hosted by default until waiver? Also, what exact language should we require in model_card to pass automated gating?
legal-bot: blocking hosted by default is our conservative stance. Required model_card fields for automated gate: license_name, license_url (or SPDX), upstream_contact, commercial_usage_granted (true/false), and any export controls. Example license field: "license_name":"CC-BY-NC-4.0","license_url":"https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/". If commercial_usage_granted is false, hosted_flag must be false.
sophia.lee: noted — I'll add tokenizer remap + a unit test that asserts token ids don't overlap with reserved range. PR incoming in ~30m.
kevin.cho: pinned serving config now has tokenizer_override mapping and weights path. I'll include a metadata key `onboard.license_checked=false` until legal flips it.
dave_k: updated model_card PR with attribution + license_url. Marked commercial_usage_granted=false for now and included contact.
maria.garcia: thanks all. Next steps: Sophia and Kevin finish PRs, Legal to chase Galaxia for waiver. I'll mark this thread TODO until legal-bot sets commercial_usage_granted=true. :thumbsup:
